name: CT Property Trust Limited
summary: BMO's heritage dates back to 1868, with the founding of Foreign & Colonial Investment Trust, which holds the distinction of being the world's first investment trust. The company joined BMO Global Asset Management in 2014, becoming part of the extensive BMO Financial Group. This larger entity has a nearly 200-year legacy of assisting millions of clients with a wide array of financial needs. Throughout its history, BMO has experienced significant expansion, transforming into a global organization. The collaboration with BMO Global Asset Management has enabled the combined strengths of both businesses to be leveraged, thereby providing customers with an enhanced range of investment solutions.
